name.value: James Joyce Bistro and Peacock Billiards

description.value: Peacock Billiards & The James Joyce Bistro is a long-established Victoria venue combining a full billiards hall with a sit-down bistro and bar, located at basement level in the downtown core. The billiards side offers table rentals, equipment sales, and hosts competitive play, while the James Joyce Bistro provides dining and drinks including a daily happy hour. It is a distinctly local institution with a noted history and art collection, as highlighted on its own website.
